description: At the open doors of an old wooden barn on a sunny day, dust hangs in the light as a young man in a grey shirt walks out carrying a large mounted moose head with antlers on his shoulder and a wooden chair in his other hand. A rolled-up old carpet lies on the ground with a beagle resting on it. The barn behind him is almost empty. Outside, people sort piles of boxes, old televisions and furniture next to a red tractor and a white farmhouse.

to stride out of the barn
